summary: Capital Southwest Corporation filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated September 10, 2026 with Deutsche Bank, Huntington, ING, Morgan Stanley, RBC and Wells Fargo as representatives for the issuance and sale of $350.0 million aggregate principal amount of 6.750% Notes due 2031. The eighth supplemental indenture with U.S. Bank Trust was executed September 15, 2026. Interest pays semi-annually March 15 and September 15 beginning March 15, 2027; maturity September 15, 2031, callable pre-August 15, 2031 at par plus make-whole. Net proceeds repay Corporate Credit Facility borrowings. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation; no equity deal terms or arbitrage angle apply.
